sentences.en: So sometimes the quotas, et cetera.

sentences.en: nations.

sentences.en: Yeah, some social skills, but mainly that they are what we call agentic in terms of the way we think about leaders.

sentences.en: And guess what?
sentences.zh: 因此，女性取得更多进步的领导领域，往往是我们不太以那种方式看待的领域。

sentences.en: And with a woman, well, she's awfully nice and she's a kind person, but we don't know if she could exert authority.
sentences.zh: 这需要很强的人际交往能力。

sentences.en: And so women are kind of, you know, behind and have something to prove.
sentences.zh: 所以女性在那里取得了很大进步。

sentences.en: So the domains of leadership in which women have made more progress are ones that we think of somewhat less in that way.

sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这很有趣，因为我认为大多数教师都是女性，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 例如，这对她们所领导的组织意味着什么？

sentences.zh: 但这并不是一种二元对立的区分。

sentences.en: But that's not, you know, a sort of a bipolar distinction.

sentences.en: and inspiring people to go along with the mission, inspiring them not just to do the best but to go beyond that, you know, to give a lot to the organization.

sentences.en: What we found was that women were slightly more transformational than men, but that that was particularly in the building of good relationships.
sentences.zh: 作为心理学家，我们知道如果可能的话，你应该使用积极的方法。

sentences.en: Again, the social piece.

sentences.en: And in terms of transactional leadership, there are, it wasn't that women were less transactional, though, there are two subtypes.

sentences.en: And so we know also that women are undermined by people not according them as much authority.

sentences.en: It's, yeah, she said that, but hey, if he said that, ooh, maybe I better pay attention.
sentences.zh: 所以这种情况是存在的。

sentences.en: So that is going on too.
sentences.zh: 他们也随着年龄增长而增加了这些认知。

sentences.en: I wouldn't say that just because women are using the more effective behaviors, of course we want to fight stereotypes in general because they categorize people.

sentences.en: And so, you know, ideally we would individuate.

sentences.en: I will think about this, you know.

sentences.en: But we can't be aware of everything at every moment.
